title: Navita Dance Hall and Hummingbird band members
summary: He recalls staying years at the Hummingbird then Navita Dance Hall and lists his band there, playing clarinet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: We stayed there for quite a number of years. And I left there and went to... Navita Dance Hall. On Aubrey Street. Between Rampart and Ugundy.
And I stayed there several years. Oh, who all was in the hummingbird? Guy Kelly?

You said? I had Guy Kelly on the trumpet.
